description: This file defines custom Cypress commands for intercepting HTTP requests related to student data, including stubbing responses for listing and mutating student records in a web application's testing environment.

methods.name: stubStudentsList
methods.description: Sets up an intercept for GET requests to the students endpoint, responding with data from a fixture file and simulating the content-range header.

methods.name: stubStudentsMutations
methods.description: Sets up intercepts for POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests to the students endpoint, returning appropriate status codes for create, update, and delete operations.
